"""Clock-driven task-space tracking, deliberately without ROS/publish capability."""
import math
import numpy as np
import warnings
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation, Slerp


def capped(vector, maximum):
    vector = np.asarray(vector, dtype=float)
    norm = np.linalg.norm(vector)
    return vector if norm <= maximum else vector * maximum / norm


def continuous_zyz(rotation, previous):
    previous = np.asarray(previous, dtype=float)
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.filterwarnings('ignore', message='Gimbal lock detected.*')
        abc = rotation.as_euler('ZYZ', degrees=True)
    alternatives = (abc, np.array([abc[0]+180, -abc[1], abc[2]+180]))
    candidates = [v + 360*np.round((previous-v)/360) for v in alternatives]
    # Preserve the existing nearest/unwrapped range (no new +/-180 clipping).
    # At singularities only A+C (B=0) or A-C (B=pi) is observable.
    if abs(math.sin(math.radians(abc[1]))) < 1e-8:
        matrix = rotation.as_matrix()
        for base in list(candidates):
            a = previous[0]
            if math.cos(math.radians(base[1])) > 0:
                c = math.degrees(math.atan2(matrix[1,0], matrix[0,0]))-a
            else:
                c = a-math.degrees(math.atan2(-matrix[1,0], -matrix[0,0]))
            c += 360*round((previous[2]-c)/360)
            value = np.array([a,base[1],c])
            if (Rotation.from_euler('ZYZ',value,degrees=True).inv()*rotation).magnitude() <= 1e-6:
                candidates.append(value)
        fixed = [v for v in candidates if v[0] == previous[0]]
        if fixed:return min(fixed, key=lambda v: np.linalg.norm(v-previous))
    return min(candidates, key=lambda v: np.linalg.norm(v-previous))


def interpolate_segment(p_start, r_start, p_end, r_end, fraction):
    """Linear position / shortest-arc quaternion Slerp; never interpolate ABC."""
    if not math.isfinite(fraction) or not 0 <= fraction <= 1:
        raise ValueError('invalid_interpolation_fraction')
    p_start,p_end=np.asarray(p_start,dtype=float),np.asarray(p_end,dtype=float)
    position=p_start+(p_end-p_start)*fraction
    rotation=Slerp([0.,1.],Rotation.from_quat([r_start.as_quat(),r_end.as_quat()]))(fraction)
    return position,rotation


class ServoShadowController:
    """Latest absolute target; actual dt dynamics; world-frame SO(3) rotation.

    This is NOT a validated physical ServoL controller. A topic publish has no
    vendor ACK, and loss-of-publisher stopping behavior remains unverified.
    """
    def __init__(self, pose_mm_zyz, limits, *, rate_hz=20., transport=None):
        if rate_hz != 20.:
            raise ValueError('experimental_rate_is_20hz')
        pose = np.asarray(pose_mm_zyz, dtype=float)
        if pose.shape != (6,) or not np.all(np.isfinite(pose)):
            raise ValueError('invalid_initial_pose')
        self.p = pose[:3].copy()
        self.r = Rotation.from_euler('ZYZ', pose[3:], degrees=True)
        self.abc = pose[3:].copy()
        self.v = np.zeros(3); self.w = np.zeros(3)
        self.tv = float(limits['translation_velocity_mm_s'])
        self.ta = float(limits['translation_acceleration_mm_s2'])
        self.rv = math.radians(limits['rotation_velocity_deg_s'])
        self.ra = math.radians(limits['rotation_acceleration_deg_s2'])
        self.age_limit = float(limits['max_action_age_sec'])
        self.workspace = limits['workspace_m']
        self.period = 1/rate_hz
        if transport is None:
            transport = dict(velocity_mm_s_deg_s=[self.tv,math.degrees(self.rv)],
                acceleration_mm_s2_deg_s2=[self.ta,math.degrees(self.ra)],target_time_s=2*self.period)
        self.transport_vel = np.asarray(transport['velocity_mm_s_deg_s'],dtype=float)
        self.transport_acc = np.asarray(transport['acceleration_mm_s2_deg_s2'],dtype=float)
        self.target_time = float(transport['target_time_s'])
        if (self.transport_vel.shape!=(2,) or self.transport_acc.shape!=(2,) or
                not np.all(np.isfinite(np.r_[self.transport_vel,self.transport_acc,self.target_time])) or
                np.any(self.transport_vel<=0) or np.any(self.transport_acc<=0) or self.target_time<=0):
            raise ValueError('invalid_servo_transport_profile')
        if (np.any(self.transport_vel+1e-12<np.array([self.tv,math.degrees(self.rv)])) or
                np.any(self.transport_acc+1e-12<np.array([self.ta,math.degrees(self.ra)]))):
            raise ValueError('transport_bounds_below_planning_limits')
        self.target = None; self.source = None; self.last_tick = None
        self.aborted = False; self.reason = None; self.stop_requests = 0
        self._workspace(self.p)

    def _workspace(self, position):
        if any(not self.workspace[k][0] <= position[i]/1000 <= self.workspace[k][1]
               for i,k in enumerate(('x','y','z'))):
            raise ValueError('workspace_rejection')

    def abort(self, reason):
        if not self.aborted:
            self.aborted = True; self.reason = reason; self.stop_requests += 1

    def pose(self):
        return np.r_[self.p, self.abc].tolist()

    def set_target(self, target_mm_zyz, source_monotonic, now):
        if self.aborted:
            raise RuntimeError('servo_inhibited')
        target = np.asarray(target_mm_zyz, dtype=float)
        if target.shape != (6,) or not np.all(np.isfinite(target)):
            self.abort('invalid_target'); raise ValueError('invalid_target')
        if not math.isfinite(source_monotonic) or not 0 <= now-source_monotonic <= self.age_limit:
            self.abort('stale_action'); raise ValueError('stale_action')
        try:self._workspace(target[:3])
        except ValueError:
            self.abort('workspace_rejection'); raise
        self.target = (target[:3].copy(),Rotation.from_euler('ZYZ',target[3:],degrees=True))
        self.source = source_monotonic  # Never reset age on periodic resampling.

    @staticmethod
    def _desired(error, speed, acceleration):
        distance = np.linalg.norm(error)
        if distance == 0:return np.zeros(3)
        return error/distance*min(speed, math.sqrt(2*acceleration*distance))

    def tick(self, now, *, health_ok=True):
        if self.aborted:raise RuntimeError('servo_inhibited:'+str(self.reason))
        if not health_ok:
            self.abort('sensor_fault'); raise RuntimeError('sensor_fault')
        if not math.isfinite(now):
            self.abort('invalid_clock'); raise ValueError('invalid_clock')
        dt = self.period if self.last_tick is None else now-self.last_tick
        if not 0 < dt <= .1:
            self.abort('servo_tick_gap'); raise RuntimeError('servo_tick_gap')
        self.last_tick = now
        if self.target is None:return None
        if not 0 <= now-self.source <= self.age_limit:
            self.abort('stale_action'); raise RuntimeError('stale_action')
        p_target,r_target = self.target
        desired_v = self._desired(p_target-self.p,self.tv,self.ta)
        desired_w = self._desired((r_target*self.r.inv()).as_rotvec(),self.rv,self.ra)
        v = self.v+capped(desired_v-self.v,self.ta*dt)
        w = self.w+capped(desired_w-self.w,self.ra*dt)
        # Slerp the local acceleration-bounded segment, NOT Euler A/B/C.
        # The endpoint is the full-step angular increment; its midpoint is
        # exactly the previous trapezoidal SO(3) update. This retains velocity
        # and acceleration behavior when a new inference changes the target.
        rotation_endpoint = Rotation.from_rotvec((self.w+w)*dt)*self.r
        p,r = interpolate_segment(self.p,self.r,self.p+(self.v+v)*dt,rotation_endpoint,.5)
        try:self._workspace(p)
        except ValueError:
            self.abort('workspace_rejection'); raise
        abc = continuous_zyz(r,self.abc)
        self.p,self.r,self.abc,self.v,self.w = p,r,abc,v,w
        return dict(topic_candidate='/dsr01/servol_stream',message_type='dsr_msgs2/msg/ServolStream',
                    pos=self.pose(),vel=self.transport_vel.tolist(),
                    acc=self.transport_acc.tolist(),time=self.target_time,
                    planning_velocity_mm_s_deg_s=[self.tv,math.degrees(self.rv)],
                    planning_acceleration_mm_s2_deg_s2=[self.ta,math.degrees(self.ra)],
                    source_monotonic=self.source,action_age_s=now-self.source,
                    translation_velocity_mm_s=v.tolist(),rotation_velocity_rad_s=w.tolist(),
                    actual_tick_dt_s=dt,command_issued=False,ack=None,
                    target_time_contract='EXPERIMENTAL_NOT_PHYSICALLY_VERIFIED')

"""Command-free exact-zero settle confirmation over distinct fresh samples."""
import math


# One existing 5 Hz control interval. A stricter temporal confirmation, not
# a new velocity tolerance or a relaxation of runtime gap/staleness gates.
SETTLE_CLEAN_SECONDS = .2
SETTLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 2.


class ExactZeroSettleWindow:
    def __init__(self):
        self.last = None
        self.clean_since = None
        self.clean_count = 0
        self.reset_count = 0

    def sample(self, row):
        now, source = row['receive'], row['source']
        velocity = row['velocity']
        if (row.get('valid') is not True or len(velocity) != 6
                or not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in [now, source, *velocity])):
            raise RuntimeError('settle_invalid_jointstate')
        if self.last is not None:
            # Polling the identical sample must not grow the window.
            if now == self.last['receive'] and source == self.last['source']:
                return False
            if not (0 < now-self.last['receive'] < .1
                    and 0 < source-self.last['source'] < .1):
                raise RuntimeError('settle_jointstate_gap_or_regression')
        self.last = row
        if any(v != 0 for v in velocity):
            self.clean_since = None
            self.clean_count = 0
            self.reset_count += 1
            return False
        if self.clean_since is None:
            self.clean_since = now
        self.clean_count += 1
        return now-self.clean_since >= SETTLE_CLEAN_SECONDS-1e-12

    def evidence(self):
        return dict(criterion='SIX_FINITE_EXACT_ZERO_VELOCITIES',
                    required_clean_seconds=SETTLE_CLEAN_SECONDS,
                    timeout_seconds=SETTLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
                    clean_sample_count=self.clean_count,reset_count=self.reset_count,
                    clean_since=self.clean_since,
                    last_receive=None if self.last is None else self.last['receive'])


def wait_for_settle(drain_samples, check_runtime, *, clock, sleep):
    """Caller supplies all newly received samples; no cached-window reuse."""
    window = ExactZeroSettleWindow()
    deadline = clock()+SETTLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
    while True:
        check_runtime()
        if clock() >= deadline:
            raise TimeoutError('settle_timeout')
        ready = False
        # Process the whole batch, including a later nonzero sample, before
        # deciding. A zero window earlier in the same batch is not sufficient.
        for row in drain_samples():
            ready = window.sample(row)
        check_runtime()
        if ready:
            if not 0 <= clock()-window.last['receive'] < .1:
                raise RuntimeError('settle_jointstate_stale')
            return dict(window.last),window.evidence()
        sleep(.005)

def _norm(v): return math.sqrt(sum(float(x)*float(x) for x in v))
def _scale_to(v, limit):
    n=_norm(v)
    if n<=limit or n==0:return tuple(v),False
    return tuple(float(x)*limit/n for x in v),True
def _accel_limit(desired, previous, max_delta):
    dv=tuple(float(a)-float(b) for a,b in zip(desired,previous)); limited,clipped=_scale_to(dv,max_delta)
    return tuple(float(b)+float(d) for b,d in zip(previous,limited)),clipped

class CanonicalActionRateLimiter:

                 max_translation_acceleration_m_s2:float=.02,
                 max_rotation_acceleration_rad_s2:float=math.radians(20)):
        vals=(control_rate_hz,max_translation_velocity_m_s,max_rotation_velocity_rad_s,
              max_translation_acceleration_m_s2,max_rotation_acceleration_rad_s2)
        if not all(math.isfinite(float(x)) and x>0 for x in vals):raise ValueError('limits_must_be_positive_finite')
        self.dt=1.0/float(control_rate_hz);self.tv=float(max_translation_velocity_m_s);self.rv=float(max_rotation_velocity_rad_s)
        self.ta=float(max_translation_acceleration_m_s2);self.ra=float(max_rotation_acceleration_rad_s2)
        self.previous_translation_velocity=(0.,0.,0.);self.previous_rotation_velocity=(0.,0.,0.)

    def limit(self, action:Sequence[float])->LimitedAction:
